afddcd263d75e709.label: MAKE
afddcd263d75e709.summary: Marine biologists identified the oldest male orca on record using Cold War nuclear bomb radiocarbon spikes preserved in tooth enamel. Hook: 'How 1960s nuclear bomb tests accidentally solved the mystery of the world's oldest whale.'
afddcd263d75e709.notes:
- Atmospheric thermonuclear bomb testing in the 1950s-60s doubled global atmospheric Carbon-14 levels ('the bomb pulse')
- Teeth and bones formed during that era locked in precise isotopic timestamps
- Dental growth layer analysis revealed orca 'J26' survived far past previous scientific lifespan estimates
- Demonstrates how geopolitical nuclear history provides accidental chronological calibration for marine biology

7cccda39ef7adf91.label: MAKE
7cccda39ef7adf91.summary: The lone star tick bite transmits alpha-gal carbohydrate molecules, causing the human immune system to develop a severe, delayed allergy to all mammalian meat. Hook: 'One bite from this tiny tick can permanently turn you into a vegetarian.'
7cccda39ef7adf91.notes:
- Unlike most allergies triggered by proteins, alpha-gal syndrome is triggered by an oligosaccharide carbohydrate
- Causes severe delayed anaphylaxis 3-8 hours after consuming mammalian meat (beef, pork, lamb, dairy)
- Tick saliva contains alpha-gal absorbed from feeding on non-human mammals, sensitizing human IgE antibodies
- Cases spreading northward across multiple continents due to warmer winters expanding tick habitat
